verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a CLI that can 'run API tests, automate monitoring, and manage collections' and even generate CI-friendly JUnit reports, which can be wired into cron/CI pipelines for background automation, and it ships an official MCP server that lets an AI agent read/modify collections and environments. However, there's no built-in scheduler or autonomous runner—automation still depends on external orchestration (cron/CI) and an agent host driving the MCP server, so it's enabling rather than fully autonomous.
